verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Yaa ayyuhal-muzzammil
Qumil-layla illaa qaleelaa
Nisfahu aw unqus minhu qaleelaa
Aw zid alayhi wa rattilil-qur'aana tarteelaa
Innaa sanulqee alayka qawlan thaqeelaa
Inna naashi'atal-layli hiya ashaddu wat'an wa aqwamu qeelaa
Inna laka fin-nahaari sabhan taweelaa
Wadhkur isma rabbika wa tabattal ilayhi tabteelaa
Rabbul-mashriqi wal-maghribi laa ilaaha illaa huwa fattakhidhhu wakeelaa
Wasbir alaa maa yaqooloona wahjurhum hajran jameelaa
Wa dharnee wal-mukadhdhibeena ulin-na'mati wa mahhilhum qaleelaa
Inna ladaynaa ankaalan wa jaheemaa
Wa ta'aaman dhaa ghussatin wa adhaaban aleemaa
Yawma tarjuful-ardu wal-jibaalu wa kaanatil-jibaalu katheeban maheelaa
Innaa arsalnaa ilaykum rasoolan shaahidan alaykum kamaa arsalnaa ilaa fir'awna rasoolaa
Fa-asaa fir'awnur-rasoola fa-akhadhnaahu akhdhan wabeelaa
Fakayfa tattaqoona in kafartum yawman yaj'alul-wildaana sheebaa
As-samaa'u munfatirun bihi kaana wa'duhu maf'oolaa
Inna haadhihi tadhkiratun faman shaa'a ittakhadha ilaa rabbihi sabeelaa

Inna rabbaka ya'lamu annaka taqoomu adnaa min thuluthayil-layli wa nisfahu wa thuluthahu wa taa'ifatun minal-ladheena ma'aka Wallaahu yuqaddirul-layla wan-nahaara alima an lan tuhsoohu fataaba alaykum faqra'oo maa tayassara minal-qur'aani alima an sayakoonu minkum mardaa wa aakharoona yadriboona fil-ardi yabtaghoona min fadlillaahi wa aakharoona yuqaatiloona fee sabeelillaahi faqra'oo maa tayassara minhu wa aqeemus-salaata wa aatuz-zakaata wa aqridoo Allaaha qardan hasanan wa maa tuqaddimoo li'nfusikum min khayrin tajidoohu indallaahi huwa khayran wa a'zama ajran wastaghfiroo Allaaha innallaaha ghafoorun Raheem
